compute_mae: compute mean absolute error between prediction and target tensors using the mae metric function
compute_mse: compute mean squared error between prediction and target tensors using the mse metric function
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between prediction and target tensors using the cosine_similarity metric function
compute_per_atom_mae: compute per-atom mean absolute error normalized by natoms using the per_atom_mae metric function
compute_energy_forces_within_threshold: compute fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03
